scope: Correct the Transformation-category roster to the current 18 CaC Awoken forms
verification_policy: Use the audited CaC roster. Transformation-category membership is distinct from the Race-subcategory research records. Do not retain cast-only or enemy-only states merely because they appear in a broad transformation index.
note: The list above contains 20 names when every staged form is listed individually. The repository's historical '18 transformations' target therefore cannot simultaneously represent every stage as an independent category record. The canonical database should treat the 18-form CaC roster as 18 transformation records only if its stage-count convention is explicitly defined; otherwise the category count must be recalculated from the chosen model. The current seeded Transformation records are demonstrably stale because they include Pure Progress, Super Saiyan Blue Kaioken, and Supersonic Mode while omitting The Power to Overcome, Super Vegeta 2, Super Saiyan 3, and Kaioken x3/x20.
